Author

Anthony Di Fiore

Published

February 5, 2026

Standard code block

No YAML chunk options specified

x <- 1
print(x)
[1] 1
log(-x)
Warning in log(-x): NaNs produced
[1] NaN

Exclude source code

Use: #| echo: false

[1] 2
Warning in log(-x): NaNs produced
[1] NaN

Exclude output

Use: #| eval: false

x <- 3
print(x)
log(-x)

Exclude warnings

Use: #| warning: false

x <- 4
print(x)
[1] 4
log(-4)
[1] NaN

Suppress everything

Use: #| include: false Use: #| echo: fenced to show entire code block

# Standard code block

No YAML chunk options specified

```{r}
x <- 1
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude source code

Use: ```#| echo: false```

```{r}
#| echo: false
x <- 2
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude output

Use: ```#| eval: false```

```{r}
#| eval: false
x <- 3
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude warnings

Use: ```#| warning: false```

```{r}
#| warning: false
x <- 4
print(x)
log(-4)
```

# Suppress everything

Use: ```#| include: false```
Use: ```#| echo: fenced``` to show entire code block

```{r}
#| echo: fenced
#| include: false
x <- 5
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Add a figure

Use: ```#| echo: fenced``` to show entire code block

```{r}
#| echo: fenced
#| out-width: "90%"
knitr::include_graphics("img/wanna_see_the_code_2x.png")
```

```{r}
#| echo: fenced
#| out-width: "4in"
knitr::include_graphics("img/wanna_see_the_code_2x.png")
```

```{r}
#| echo: fenced
#| out-height: "4in"
knitr::include_graphics("img/pvz-zombie1.pdf")
```
